verdict.rationale: This Warp is an HR/payroll platform with its own Warp Agent, so letting users plug external MCP servers into that agent is a fair capability to ask about. The only MCP evidence shows the opposite direction: Warp exposes itself to external MCP clients such as Claude and ChatGPT, which is server-side and earns no credit here. Nothing in the pack documents Warp consuming third-party MCP servers or their tools.
